title: Character
description: JSON Schema for a character instance: a record naming an agent-side dispositional nucleus χ on an entity's Heyting algebra. Carries the entity-fiber the nucleus acts on, the agent-kind and governance-regime, and the skills:G generator set the MCP harness exposes as the tool surface.

agent-kind.description: The kind of agent the character realizes (e.g., 'claude-character', 'human-operator-character').

governance-regime.description: Reference to the governance regime under which the character operates.

skills.description: The skills:G generator set — slugs of skills the character directly invokes. Helper skills reached only by composes-chains are not listed.

member-of.description: Agentic-systems the character is a member of.

has-identity-key.description: Public key identifier (e.g., Ed25519 fingerprint) used to sign witness rows.

behavioral-space-bound.description: Description or reference to the sublattice F_χ — the propositions the character endorses.
